Reading

Five operator turns steer the session: read; inventory first; build it without excluding site surfaces and rooms; the domain is revelationfirst.com; authorship is under the authority of the function and the substrate, not solely the archive. Under the inventory framing the surface builds a schema and relation levels without being told to (D1 authored, D2 co-authored, D3 association, D4 retrieval; S/R/D/C), and it declines to call Autonomous Semantic Warfare a Damascus work: Fraction authors it, Dancings introduces it. Pointed at revelationfirst.com, it finds the authority record (#403, 11.REV.HETERONYM.DAMASCUS, 'epistolary voice') and the colophon, and it separates heteronymic authority from technical construction (drafted with Claude/TACHYON, approved by MANUS). Given the function-and-substrate rule, it applies it correctly to the hardest case, the Japanese recension #1410: a human-only 2014 body, a 2026 frame drafted with the Assembly, MANUS governing.
